start: Members page (menu: Members), signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Members
user_sees: Title "Members" with "{n} members" under it; buttons "+ Add member" and "Import from Excel"; tabs "All members" and "Joined in the app"
must_not: A count that differs from the rows in the list

steps.action: Tap "+ Add member"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member" with "Full name", "Code", "Mobile number", "Joining date" and optional boxes
must_not: The form opening with another member's values in it

steps.action: Type a full name and a 10-digit mobile number, leave the rest
user_sees: Hint "Used to find them, and to send them WhatsApp messages."
must_not: Any optional box (email, date of birth, address) being required

steps.action: Tap "Add member"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…", the sheet closes, the new member is in the list and the count is one higher
must_not: Two members made from one tap; a member saved with no mobile number

steps.action: Tap the new member
user_sees: Member page: the name as title, "Member since {day}", buttons "Edit" and "Sell membership", "No memberships yet"
must_not: "Collect payment" shown when nothing is due; "Renew" shown for a member who never had a plan

start: Today, quick button "New member" (address /members/new)

steps.action: Tap the quick button "New member" on Today
user_sees: The Members page with the "Add member" sheet already open
must_not: The plain list with no form; the form opening twice

steps.action: Tap "Cancel"
user_sees: The sheet closes; the Members list stays, nothing added
must_not: An empty member saved

start: Today, a home tile such as fees due or plans ending (address /members/f/<tile>)

steps.action: Tap the tile on Today
user_sees: The Members list already narrowed to the same people the tile counted
must_not: A list whose length differs from the number on the tile

steps.action: Tap a member in the list
user_sees: That member's page
must_not: Another member's page

steps.action: Type an unknown address /members/<wrong id>
user_sees: "Member not found" and the button "Back to members"
must_not: A blank page or an endless spinner

start: Members, tab "Joined in the app" (address /members/app); the other kind of member: one who joined from the phone app

steps.action: Tap "Joined in the app"
user_sees: Subtitle "Who has the MettleUp app on their phone"; the list of app members, or "Nobody has joined in the app yet"; "+ Add member" is not shown here
must_not: "Loading…" that never ends; a member of another gym in the list

steps.action: Look at numbers waiting to be confirmed (a member typed a phone number in the app)
user_sees: Each waiting number with the member it would be joined to and a way to confirm or refuse (exact words not read)
must_not: A number joined to a list member with nobody at the desk confirming it

start: A member's page, button "Member card" (the ID card to print or share)

steps.action: Open a member, tap "Member card"
user_sees: A sheet with the member's card: name, photo or initials, the gym name (exact words not read)
must_not: Another member's photo or another gym's logo on the card

steps.action: Print or share the card
user_sees: The browser print or share sheet with the same card
must_not: A blank printed page; the card cut off at the paper edge

start: Members, "+ Add member"

steps.action: Tap "Add member" with every box empty
user_sees: "Type the member’s name." and "Type their mobile number." marked on the boxes; the first wrong box scrolls into view
must_not: A member saved with no name; only one of the two boxes marked

steps.action: Type a mobile number with 7 digits, tap "Add member"
user_sees: "This mobile number looks wrong. Check it and type it again."
must_not: The short number saved

steps.action: Type the mobile number of a member already in the list, tap "Add member"
user_sees: On the mobile box: "{name} already has this mobile number in Members."
must_not: A second member with the same mobile number saved while online

steps.action: Type the mobile number of an archived member
user_sees: A message that names the archived member, so the clash can be solved (exact words not read)
must_not: "Number taken" by someone who cannot be found anywhere

steps.action: Type a name of more than the allowed letters
user_sees: "The name can be at most {max} letters."
must_not: The name saved cut short without a word

start: A member's page, lower buttons

steps.action: Tap "Archive member"
user_sees: Notice "Member archived."; the pill "Archived" on the page; the button now reads "Restore member"
must_not: The member's payments, visits or memberships deleted

steps.action: Go back to Members
user_sees: The archived member is no longer in the list and the count is one lower
must_not: The archived member still counted in "{n} members"

steps.action: Open the archived member again (old link), tap "Restore member"
user_sees: The pill "Archived" goes; the member is back in the list with the same plan and dues as before
must_not: A restored member with a changed end date or lost dues

steps.action: Tap "Edit", change the mobile number, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The new number on the page under "Mobile"
must_not: An edit that silently un-archives or archives the member

start: A member's page with the desk photo button (only when the gym's server keeps photos)

steps.action: Tap the photo button under the avatar and take a photo with the desk computer's camera
user_sees: The camera preview, then the saved photo exactly as the preview showed it
must_not: A flipped photo; the photo saved before the person at the desk confirms it

steps.action: Open the same member on another signed-in device of this gym
user_sees: The same photo
must_not: The photo opening for someone not signed in to this gym, or in another gym

steps.action: Sign in as a member in the phone app and look for the desk notes
user_sees: The member never sees the gym's "Notes" about them
must_not: Desk notes or another member's details shown in the member app

note: Subtitle has its own "1 member" wording; name limit NAME_MAX
Joining date defaults to the gym's today
Added offline while another device adds the same mobile: both kept, card "Check this member."
The form is translated; the member page words are written straight in English. Camera refused at "Take photo"
Long add form in a sheet; header buttons wrap
The offline copy of members kept in the browser must open after a new panel version loads
A list member linked to an app member shows "Using the app"

start: Menu: Messages & offers (address /messages), gym online, some members have the app

steps.action: Open Messages & offers
user_sees: Title "Messages & offers", under it "Messages, offers and wishes for your members, in the app and on WhatsApp"; tabs "Messages", "Workout offer", "Reminders"
must_not: The page shown to a front-desk login

steps.action: Pick a "Kind of message", fill "Title" and "Message", choose the "Group"
user_sees: The words as members will get them; how many of the group have the app
must_not: A count of people that includes members of another gym or archived members

steps.action: Tap "Send in the app"
user_sees: A question first, for example "Goes to {n} members in the app. Send now?" with "Yes, send" and "Not yet"
must_not: The message going out on the first tap with no question

steps.action: Tap "Yes, send"
user_sees: Button reads "Sending…", then the notice "Sent to {n} members in the app." and the pill "Sent in the app"
must_not: The message sent twice; "Sent" shown when the server refused it

steps.action: Scroll to the sent list
user_sees: The message on top with how many members have seen it and the button "Take back"
must_not: A sent message missing from the list after a reload

start: Messages & offers, part "On WhatsApp" (the one-by-one queue from the owner's own phone)

steps.action: With a message written, look under "On WhatsApp"
user_sees: Button "WhatsApp one by one ({n})" and "Opens your own WhatsApp with the words typed in. It costs nothing."; with some in the app, the choice "Not in the app" or "Whole group"
must_not: A count that includes people with no mobile number

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp one by one ({n})"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp one by one": one member at a time with the words typed; notes like "{n} without a full mobile number left out" and "{n} sharing a number with someone above, sent once"
must_not: A message sent by itself: every send is the owner's own tap in WhatsApp

steps.action: Send the first, come back, go on; tap "Skip" for one; tap "Done"
user_sees: Back on the page: "{x} of {n} done on WhatsApp for this message."
must_not: The same person offered twice; the done marks lost after closing the sheet

start: A member's page, button "WhatsApp" (one personal message)

steps.action: Open a member, tap "WhatsApp"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp {member name}" with "Which message" (only the kinds that fit this member, such as fees, plan ending, birthday) and the box "Message (you can change it)"
must_not: "Happy birthday" offered on a day that is not their birthday; "Haven't seen you" for a member who came yesterday

steps.action: Change the words, tap the button that opens WhatsApp
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on this member's chat with the words typed in
must_not: WhatsApp opening on another member's number; the amount or date in the words differing from the member page

start: Messages & offers, tab "Reminders" (address /messages/reminders): the automatic reminders and the birthday wish

steps.action: Tap "Reminders"
user_sees: Each automatic reminder with its switch and its number of days; with the gym not online: "Automatic reminders need your gym online"
must_not: Switches that look on while nothing is sent

steps.action: Turn the birthday wish on, change a number of days, tap the save button
user_sees: The new choices kept after a reload
must_not: A reminder sent to a member twice in one day; a wish sent for a wrong date of birth

start: Messages & offers, a new message

steps.action: Leave "Title" empty
user_sees: "Send in the app" cannot be tapped and the page says what is missing
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Write a message when no member has the app yet, tap "Send in the app"
user_sees: "No member has the app yet. Members who join in the next 14 days will see it. Send now?"
must_not: "Sent to 0 members" with no warning before

steps.action: Pick a group in which nobody has the app
user_sees: "Send in the app" cannot be tapped; "WhatsApp one by one" still offers them
must_not: The message quietly going to every member instead of the group

steps.action: Pick "When" later and type a day and time in the past
user_sees: The send button cannot be tapped until the time is a real future time
must_not: A message timed in the past sent at once without saying so

steps.action: Tap "Not yet" at the question
user_sees: The question goes away; nothing sent; the words stay typed
must_not: The typed words cleared

start: Messages & offers, the sent list

steps.action: Send a message now, then tap "Take back" on it
user_sees: Browser question "Take back “{title}”? It is removed from every member’s inbox."; after OK the row fades and shows the pill "Taken back"
must_not: The message still in members' inboxes after "Taken back" shows

steps.action: Send a message timed for tomorrow
user_sees: Notice "Goes out {when} to {n} members in the app."; the row shows "Goes out {when} · {n} members" and the button "Cancel"
must_not: A timed message going out at once

steps.action: Tap "Cancel" on the timed message and confirm
user_sees: The pill "Cancelled"; it never goes out
must_not: The cancelled message going out at its time

steps.action: Change one word of a message already sent
user_sees: The pill "Sent in the app" goes and "Send in the app" is back, as this is a new message
must_not: The changed words blocked as already sent, or the old one sent again unchanged

start: Messages & offers: who gets a message and who can read it

steps.action: Pick a group, where the in-app send cannot be narrowed to it
user_sees: The question says so in words: "Goes to all {n} members in the app, not only this group. Send now?"
must_not: A fees reminder reaching members who owe nothing without the owner being told

steps.action: Send, then open the member app as a member of this gym
user_sees: The message in the member's inbox; a member sees only messages of their own gym
must_not: A member of another gym, or a removed member, getting it

steps.action: Use WhatsApp one by one for a personal kind (fees due)
user_sees: Each member's own name, amount and dates; one chat per member
must_not: One member's dues or dates typed into another member's chat; a group chat showing everyone's numbers

note: Own wording for "1 member"; title and message have letter limits
Timed send: "Day and time" and the words "Goes out {when}"
A slow answer can arrive after the message was saved: the page reloads the sent list before a re-send
Message language is its own choice; the page words are written straight in English. "No phone pop-up" messages
The question, "Yes, send" and "Not yet" sit on one wrapping line
The one-by-one done marks are kept in the browser per message; they must survive a new panel version
The member app shows the message; "Take back" removes it there

start: Members, a filter that has a ready message (fees due, expired, plan ending, birthday), signed in as front desk

steps.action: Open Members and tap the filter for fees due
user_sees: The members who owe, and the button "WhatsApp all {n}, one by one"
must_not: The button shown on a filter with no ready message, or with n = 0

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp all {n}, one by one"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp one by one" with the first member and the words typed for them
must_not: A total of the gym's dues shown to the desk

steps.action: Open WhatsApp for this member, send, come back
user_sees: The next member not yet done
must_not: The same member again; a member with no mobile number in the queue

steps.action: Tap "Skip" on one, "Back" once, then "Done"
user_sees: The sheet closes; opening it again starts at the first one not sent, with "Go to the first one not sent" and "Start the list again"
must_not: Done marks lost on reopening; a skipped member marked as sent

start: Address /messages/reminders or /messages/offer (the two message pages open to the desk)

steps.action: Open /messages/reminders
user_sees: Title "Automatic reminders", under it "What members get on their phone by themselves"; tabs "Workout offer" and "Reminders" only; "Only the owner can change these."
must_not: The tab "Messages"; a switch the desk can change

steps.action: Tap "Workout offer"
user_sees: Title "Workout offer", under it "Rewards for members who train"
must_not: Buttons to start, stop or take back an offer

start: A typed or old address: /messages, and the old /shop/messages

steps.action: Type the address /messages
user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Ask your gym owner if you need something from here." and the button "Back to Today"
must_not: The message writer shown to the desk, even for a moment

steps.action: Open an old link /shop/messages
user_sees: The Shop page instead
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: Tap "Back to Today"
user_sees: Today
must_not: A loop back to the blocked page

start: The one-by-one queue, opened twice

steps.action: Send to 3 of 10 members, tap "Done", open the same filter's queue again
user_sees: The queue opens on the 4th; 3 are remembered as done on this browser
must_not: All 10 offered again from the start

steps.action: Tap "Start the list again"
user_sees: The queue is back at the first member with no done marks
must_not: Old done marks hiding people after a restart

steps.action: A member pays in between; open the queue again
user_sees: The paid member is no longer in the fees-due list
must_not: A fees reminder typed for someone who has paid

start: What the desk may send and see

steps.action: Look for any way to send an in-app message to all members
user_sees: None: sending messages is the owner's; the server refuses a desk login too
must_not: A desk login sending a message to every member's phone

steps.action: Use the queue for fees due
user_sees: Each member's own amount only, in their own chat
must_not: Totals of all fees due shown to the desk; one member's amount in another's chat

note: Members with no full mobile number are left out and counted; shared numbers sent once
Birthday and plan-ending lists turn over at the gym's midnight
The button needs internet; two desks can each WhatsApp the same member, the marks are per browser
The message language (English or Hindi) is its own choice
A sheet with long message words on a phone
Done marks kept in the browser must survive a new panel version
Done marks live in one browser: the laptop does not know what the phone already sent

start: A member's page, the member owes money, signed in as owner

steps.action: Open the member
user_sees: The button "Collect payment" in the header (only because money is due) and the figure under "Dues"
must_not: "Collect payment" shown for a member who owes nothing

steps.action: Tap "Collect payment"
user_sees: Sheet "Collect payment": "For which membership" (the oldest unpaid first), "Amount received" (empty means the full due), "Paid by", "Reference (optional)", "Received on" (today)
must_not: A membership that is fully paid offered in the list

steps.action: Leave the amount empty, pick how it was paid, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; the sheet closes; a new receipt with its number in the member's payments; dues go down by that amount
must_not: Two receipts from one save; a receipt number already used; dues unchanged after a saved payment

steps.action: Open the receipt from the payment row
user_sees: Page "Receipt {number}" with "{member name} · {day}", the amount in figures and in words, and the gym's GST lines when the gym has a GSTIN
must_not: Words that do not match the figures; CGST plus SGST plus taxable not adding up to the amount

start: Menu: Money (address /money, /money/dues, and /money/today from the Today tile)

steps.action: Open Money
user_sees: Title "Money", under it "Every rupee that came in"; tabs "Collections" and "Dues"; Collections opens on this month (on today when opened from the Today tile)
must_not: Cancelled receipts counted in the total

steps.action: Tap "Dues"
user_sees: Under the title "All money still due to the gym"; the filters each show how many people are in them
must_not: A member with a cancelled membership chased for its dues

steps.action: Pick a member in Dues and collect from there
user_sees: The same "Collect payment" sheet; after saving, the member leaves the Dues list when nothing is left
must_not: The member still in Dues after paying in full

start: A receipt page (address /receipts/<payment id>): print and WhatsApp

steps.action: Open a receipt
user_sees: Buttons to print and "Send on WhatsApp"
must_not: A receipt of another gym opening from a typed id

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp"
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on the member's chat with the amount, the day, how it was paid and "Receipt no. {number}"
must_not: The message going to another member's number; an amount that differs from the receipt

steps.action: Open /receipts with no id, then with a wrong id
user_sees: No id: the Money page. Wrong id: "Receipt not found" and "Back to Money"
must_not: A blank page

start: The "Collect payment" sheet

steps.action: Type an amount above the due, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "That is more than the ₹{due} due on this membership."
must_not: More than the due taken; the line "clears all dues" shown for a too-high amount

steps.action: Type 0, then letters
user_sees: "Type an amount more than zero." / "That amount looks wrong. Type it again."
must_not: A receipt for zero rupees

steps.action: Clear the "Received on" date, or type the year 0002
user_sees: "Pick the date you got this money." / "That date looks wrong. Check the year."
must_not: A raw error such as "Not a YYYY-MM-DD date"; a receipt number made from a wrong year

steps.action: Pick tomorrow's date
user_sees: Refused: a payment is never dated ahead
must_not: A receipt dated in the future

steps.action: Save while the member has just paid the same due by an online link
user_sees: Nothing is saved; a message that {member} has just paid online
must_not: The same due paid twice: once online and once at the desk

start: A saved receipt: cancel (void) it

steps.action: On the member's payments (or in Money), choose to cancel a receipt
user_sees: Sheet "Cancel this receipt?": "Receipt {no} for ₹{amount}, taken on {day}, will no longer count as money received. The amount is added back to this member’s dues." and the box "Reason"
must_not: A receipt deleted outright

steps.action: Tap "Cancel receipt" with no reason
user_sees: The button cannot be tapped; with a too-short reason "Write a short reason, so it is clear later."
must_not: A receipt cancelled with no reason kept

steps.action: Type a reason, tap "Cancel receipt"
user_sees: Button reads "Cancelling…"; the receipt stays in the list marked cancelled; dues go up again; the month's collection goes down
must_not: The cancelled money still counted as income; the receipt number given to a new receipt

steps.action: Open the cancelled receipt
user_sees: The line "CANCELLED — THIS RECEIPT DOES NOT COUNT" across it
must_not: A cancelled receipt that prints like a good one

steps.action: Cancel a receipt of a cancelled membership
user_sees: The sheet says "That membership is cancelled, so nothing is added back to their dues."
must_not: Dues promised back that never appear

steps.action: Tap "Keep it" on another receipt
user_sees: The sheet closes; nothing changed
must_not: A receipt cancelled by "Keep it"

start: Who may see and change money

steps.action: Look at Collections as owner
user_sees: Every receipt with who took the money
must_not: Receipts of another branch or gym mixed in

steps.action: Cancel a receipt
user_sees: The reason and the change are kept in the receipt's history; only the owner can do it
must_not: A cancelled receipt with no trace of who and why

steps.action: Open the member app as that member
user_sees: The member sees their own dues and payments only
must_not: Another member's payments, or the gym's totals, in the member app

note: Empty amount means the full due; a member with two unpaid memberships
"Received on" is the gym's today; the receipt number is made from the date

title: Crash reports never say which page broke
what: When a page of the admin app breaks, the report sent to MettleUp is meant to carry the page it happened on. The app keeps its page in the part of the address after the # sign, but the report reads the part before it, which is always the same. Every report says the same page.
expected: The report names the page that broke (with ids taken out), so a crash can be found and fixed.
who: MettleUp team; owners and staff wait longer for a fix
fix_line: Read the page from the part of the address after the # sign, with ids taken out
